### Affordable, reliable water
Protect our water supply, safeguard water quality, and insist on transparent rates that respect working families.

### Flood protection that works

Where Phuong stands
## Practical policies.
Measurable results.
Water policy should be understandable, accountable, and rooted in the daily needs of District 6 families.
01
### Reliable, affordable water
Protect long-term supply, strengthen conservation partnerships, and demand clear, transparent rates.
02
### Flood-safe neighborhoods
Prioritize dam and levee safety, creek maintenance, and emergency readiness where the risk is greatest.
03
### Healthy creeks and watersheds
Reduce pollution, restore habitat, and invest in nature-based solutions that make our region more resilient.
04
### Open, accountable government
Use plain-language budgets, accessible meetings, and regular District 6 updates so residents can follow major decisions.
05
### Community voice in every project
Bring multilingual outreach and neighborhood roundtables into planning early—not after decisions are already made.
06
### Good jobs and fair contracting
Expand pathways into water careers and ensure qualified local, small, and diverse businesses can compete for public work.
Meet Phuong
## Public service that starts with listening.
Phuong has built his career helping residents navigate government—and making sure community concerns reach decision-makers.
As a Field Representative in the Office of State Senator Dave Cortese and a former member of the Santa Clara County Democratic Central Committee, Phuong has worked alongside neighborhood advocates, nonprofits, labor, community leaders, and public agencies.
He helped bring attention and government response to vandalism affecting Little Saigon businesses and the theft of culturally significant statues from the Viet Heritage Garden. On the Valley Water Board, he’ll bring that same accessible, collaborative, and accountable approach.
Ask Phuong a question →
“District 6 deserves a voice that shows up, listens closely, and turns community concerns into action.”
— Phuong Nguyen
Showing up for our community
## Ready to serve.
Ready to lead.
Phuong’s campaign is grounded in public service, civic participation, and conversations with the people who call District 6 home.
Focused on Valley Water’s mission
Stepping forward to serveListening in the community
Rooted here
## A voice for every
District 6 neighborhood.
From central and east San José to the foothills, our communities share one water future. Phuong will bring multilingual, accessible outreach into major decisions—and report back on how community input shaped the result.
- Regular District 6 community roundtables
- Plain-language budgets and project updates
- Fair access to contracts and water careers
